Hi Martin. Your Power K. went out separately with UPS and shows as delivered today: (tracking link hidden)

Your B30 hasn't shipped yet. It's waiting on the B30 stock that's being checked in at our Netherlands warehouse. I'm sorry, the November 15 date we gave you has now passed. I've asked the team to confirm the new date, and someone will get back to you with it by email.

You can follow that shipment at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Your Magic M. 40T on Shop···· ships November 30, 2026. Your Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA is part of the same order. The order is paid in full and nothing has shipped yet. Your unit ships from our Netherlands warehouse once the 40T stock lands there. We'll email you the tracking as soon as it leaves.

You can follow that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Is there anything else you'd like me to check?

Hi, I’m not sure if you realize this, but I ordered both miners specifically to use them for heating. At this rate, they won’t arrive until around June of next year. I’m already dreading the condition in which they might (eventually) arrive—if they even work at all. And a complimentary wattmeter certainly won’t soothe my frustration. I truly hope you manage to ship something by at least one of the promised dates. Best regards.

Martin, you're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry. You ordered the B30 on July 20 and the 40T on September 18 so you'd have heat this winter. We've missed date after date on both.

Here's where they stand today. Your 40T ships November 30. Your B30 is waiting on stock that's being checked in at our Netherlands warehouse, and we're confirming its new date.

I've passed your message to the team, including that you need these units for heating. Someone will pick up your ticket and get back to you by email with firm dates.
